description.p: File Flier is a fast file manager built for the keyboard. Start typing to filter a folder instantly, jump anywhere with the command palette, and work in tabs and split panes.

ul.li: Tabs and split panes, with drag-and-drop between them
Details, list and thumbnail grid views
Instant type-to-filter and recursive fuzzy search
Command palette and a Go To box with path completion
Inspector that previews text, images and folders
Bookmarks, recent folders, drives and network shares in the sidebar
Eight themes, custom accent colors, adjustable size and an optional frosted glass style
Quick Look previews, inline rename and undo

screenshot.caption: Split panes with a thumbnail grid and the inspector
Searchable context menu with keyboard shortcuts

ul.li: The disk space bar in the sidebar now shows your home drive, and works inside Flatpak
Hover a drive to see how much space is free
Clearer instructions for enabling "Open terminal here", and an error when no terminal app is found
Quick Look: press Space for a large preview and browse with the arrow keys
Rename files in place with F2
Undo (Ctrl+Z) for renames, moves, copies, new items and moving to the trash
Optional frosted glass style, with desktop blur on KDE Plasma and macOS
Smooth animations throughout, which can be turned off
AppImage mounts no longer show up as drives
New Settings window (Ctrl+,)
Eight themes: File Pilot Dark, Light, Midnight, Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin Mocha, Gruvbox and Solarized Light
Custom accent colors, interface size and row density
Relative or friendly date formats
Option to restore your tabs from last time
